# Dream Islands

> Dream Islands is an AI-powered wellness travel platform that helps people find the most appropriate wellness, longevity, rehabilitation, and preventive health programs based on their goals, health profile, and preferences. Its proprietary Wellness Baseline Score (WBS) assesses physical, mental, and lifestyle factors to match each guest with suitable partner programs and specialists. Dream Islands does not provide medical care directly. Medical services, where included, are delivered by licensed physicians and healthcare providers at partner clinics and retreat centers.

## Assessment

- [Wellness Baseline Assessment](https://dreamislands.org/start): a free, ~5-minute, 22-question score across movement, recovery, lifestyle risk and emotional health, used to match guests to programs and track outcomes before, during and after a stay.

## Program tracks

- Reset — down-regulate, detox, re-sleep
- Performance — train smarter, rebuild capacity
- Mind — calm the nervous system, restore focus
- Immersion — composite, longer-stay protocols
- [Browse all programs](https://dreamislands.org/programs)

## Flagship partner

Tanya Samui Holistic Health Retreat (Koh Samui, Thailand) is Dream Islands' flagship pilot partner and the primary operating case for the WBS-guided matching model — an independently owned and operated wellness retreat with a 15-year operating history. It is not owned or operated by Dream Islands.

- [Tanya Samui](https://dreamislands.org/tanya-samui)
- [Tanya Samui FAQ](https://dreamislands.org/tanya-samui/faq) — 23 real Q&A covering the protocol, medical safety, payment and logistics.

## Partner network

Beyond Tanya Samui, Dream Islands matches guests to certified partner properties and clinics across Indonesia, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam and China, spanning resorts, medical wellness centers and specialist clinics.

- [Browse all properties](https://dreamislands.org/properties)

## Legal

Dream Islands operates as a Destination Marketing Organization (DMO) promoting wellness travel. It does not provide medical or psychiatric services directly and is not a medical institution. Content on this site is informational only and does not constitute medical advice.
